description:
What should I do for you to stop doing these kinds of things?

*"You are wrong, Miss Haewon. Don't think of taming me , but think of tying the leash on me."

"It's not like you will stay still if I tie the leash on you."

"Huh? Do I look like that?"*

Ah Dam smiled and asked.

*"But Miss Haewon, you keep avoiding me."*

That's why I even thought of just pounding on you.

*"Please give me some love, Then I will listen to you well."*

Ah Dam straightened his head and smiled at me.

*"Hmmm? Miss Haewon?"*

Ah Dam ' s eyes were filled with joy when he called out Haewon ' s name as if he was possessed by a passionate dream. Like an alpha who met his fateful partner.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
